                         2026 Ohio Estimated Income Tax Payment Worksheet (DO NOT FILE)
  1. Expected 2026 federal adjusted gross income..........................................................................................1.
  2. Net expected 2026 adjustments from the Ohio Schedule of Adjustments .................................................2.
  3. Line 1 plus line 2........................................................................................................................................3.
  4. Multiply your expected number of exemptions by $1,900* ........................................................................4.
  5. Line 3 minus line 4. If zero or negative, stop here .....................................................................................5.
  6. Use the tax brackets below to calculate the liability on line 5 ....................................................................6.
  7. Expected total credits. Use Ohio Schedule of Credits ...............................................................................7.
  8. Estimated 2026 Ohio income tax liability. Line 6 minus line 7 ...................................................................8.
  9. 2025 Ohio income tax liability. 2025 IT 1040, line 10 minus line 16 ...............................................................9.
 10. Multiply line 8 by 90% (.90) .....................................................................................................................10.
 11. Enter the lesser of line 9 or line 10 (If you did not file a 2025 IT 1040, enter the amount from line 10) .. 11.
 12. 2025 credit carryforward and expected 2026 Ohio income tax withholding ............................................12.
 13. Estimated required installment. Line 11 minus line 12 ............................................................................13.
 14. Your quarterly estimated payment. Multiply line 13 by 25% (.25) .......................................................14.
